digest.component_or_area: tickets-branch push delivery and workflow automation
propositions: Duplicate CAS push and retry loops across workflows were consolidated into a single Python core module (src/rebar/_store/push.py) that owns fetch-merge-retry semantics with a five-cycle budget.

The strict push entrypoint raises typed PushDeliveryError and exits nonzero on exhausted retries; best-effort mode (default) preserves backward compatibility for library, CLI, MCP, and importer callers.
Bridge and canary workflows now delegate outbound delivery exactly once through locked Python commit-and-push or push-adapter entrypoints instead of maintaining their own fetch/merge/retry loops.
Locked commit-and-push operation stages, commits, and delivers the workflow transaction with established bot identity and subject while preserving dirty-tree handling and commit recovery on failure.
Existing Python interfaces, CLI commands, and MCP protocol behavior remain unchanged; strictness is explicit and opt-in at workflow boundaries only.
